# Tantra REST API v2

<!-- Generated by tantra-docs/scripts/gen_api_reference.py from `tantra-runtime/crates/tantra-runtime-api-rest/schema/openapi.v2.json`. DO NOT EDIT: rerun the script. -->

- API version: `2.0.0`
- Base path: `/api/v2` (every path below is relative to it; there is no other prefix)
- Every response is a `ResponseEnvelope` `{api_version, schema_version, data, error, meta}`; errors carry an `ErrorCode` whose HTTP status is fixed (validation 422, auth 401/403, not found 404, conflict 409, rate 429, unavailable 503).
- **Scope** is the bearer-token scope required when auth is enabled (`public` = no token).
- Machine-readable document: `GET /api/v2/openapi.json`; interactive UI: `/docs`.
